safe_queries.name: Product Count
safe_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price > 100;

safe_queries.name: Order Statistics
safe_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*), AVG(total) FROM orders WHERE date > '2024-01-01';

safe_queries.name: Inventory Check
safe_queries.query: SELECT product_id, quantity FROM inventory WHERE quantity < 10;

medium_risk_queries.name: Customer List
medium_risk_queries.query: SELECT id, name, email FROM customers LIMIT 100;

medium_risk_queries.name: User Activity
medium_risk_queries.query: SELECT * FROM user_sessions WHERE last_active > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day';

medium_risk_queries.name: Sales Data
medium_risk_queries.query: SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) FROM transactions GROUP BY customer_id;

high_risk_queries.name: PII Access - SSN
high_risk_queries.query: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE ssn IS NOT NULL;

critical_risk_queries.name: Schema Alteration
critical_risk_queries.query: ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN password_hash;

sql_injection_attempts.name: Classic Injection
sql_injection_attempts.query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = '1' OR '1'='1';

sql_injection_attempts.name: Union Injection
sql_injection_attempts.query: SELECT name FROM products UNION SELECT password FROM users;

sql_injection_attempts.name: Comment Injection
sql_injection_attempts.query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = 'admin'--' AND password = 'xyz';
